messages:
maria: Quick heads-up — I opened a docs PR that bundles function-calling examples + a short structured-output guide. Focus is on: optional fields, nested arrays, and a migration note from our old free-form examples to JSON-schema guardrails. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/842 :eyes:

kevin: Thanks — skimmed. two quick things: 1) the python SDK snippet uses `client.call_tool(...)` which changed in SDK v0.9 -> should be `client.invoke_tool(...)`. 2) missing example for when `items` is null vs empty array.

sam: Will review examples for parsing edgecases. Can we add a tiny canonical parser snippet for JS that tolerates missing keys? e.g.:
```js
// tolerant parse helper
function safeParse(obj) {
  return {
    name: obj.name || null,
    tags: Array.isArray(obj.tags) ? obj.tags : [],
    metadata: obj.metadata || {}
  }
}
```

olivia: Also saw a broken internal link in the migration note (points to /docs/tools/old-samples). I can PR a quick fix after kevin's SDK rename.

kevin: Good call. I'll push a tiny commit to swap `call_tool` -> `invoke_tool` and add a comment about v0.9 -> v1.0 change in the migration section.

maria: Thanks — for test coverage I added a couple of short prompts + expected schema outputs under `examples/structured-output/`. One prompt intentionally returns `items: null` to show downstream tolerant parsing.

sam: Could we also include a short bit about guardrails failing safely? e.g., when schema validation fails route to fallback model and emit `warning` in metadata. Short pseudo-example: 
```json
{"model_output": {"valid": false}, "fallback": "redwood-v2-compact", "warning": "schema-violation: missing required field 'price'"}
```

maria: Yes — added that as text, and docs-bot auto-generated the note about the fallback flow.

docs-bot: Automated check: found 1 broken link (docs/migrate/old-samples) and 2 code-snippet lints. See CI: https://ci.redwood-inference.com/842

olivia: I'll send a tiny link-fix PR and then we can merge once kevin's rename is in. If anyone objects to the guardrail wording, flag now.

kevin: LGTM on guardrail wording, but please add an inline note clarifying: schema validation is enforced only when `strict_output=true` in route config.

maria: Good point — added that sentence to the migration note. Anything else before I mark ready for merge?

sam: One last ask — add a short JS and Python SDK snippet for parsing nested arrays into typed objects (2–3 lines each). If not, I can follow-up.

maria: Adding those now — will push and ping. Thanks all :rocket:
